758:t_1:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... $$クロウ$$ seems weighed down by his debt. I wonder what everyone else is doing now...」

758:t_1:48.en:
$$エスター$$
「I'm sure they're doing their best in their own worlds. They're all members of $c, after all.」

758:t_1:53.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm not going anywhere anymore. I'll live with you in this world.」

758:t_1:54.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm not a $$特異点$$ now. I'm just $$桂木桂$$... your very own $$桂木桂$$.」

758:t_1:55.en:
$$シャイア$$
「You two... Getting lovey-dovey on the bridge is against the rules.」

758:t_1:56.en:
$$ジャビー$$
「Please hurry to the living room. The Captain's struggling with the twin babies.」

758:t_1:57.en:
$$ミムジィ$$
「I'm sorry, $$シャイア$$, $$ジャビー$$.」

758:t_1:58.en:
$$桂$$
「Still, I was surprised the Captain had come back to life.」

758:t_1:59.en:
$$ミムジィ$$
「It sounds like the Captain went through a lot, traveling through various multiverses.」

758:t_1:60.en:
$$桂$$
「And the true space-time repair brought him back to this world.」

758:t_1:61.en:
$$モーム$$
「Honestly, $$桂$$! Looking after children is the father's job!」

758:t_1:63.en:
$$アテナ$$
「Even the $$特異点$$ who saved the world loses his dignity in front of children.」

758:t_1:64.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But that's exactly what $$桂$$ has always wanted.」

758:t_1:65.en:
$$アテナ$$
「He wanted to come home here... He kept fighting to make that happen.」

758:t_1:66.en:
$$オルソン$$
「The same goes for me.」

758:t_1:67.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't stand there like this has nothing to do with you, $$オルソン$$! Look after your little brother and sister too!」

758:t_1:68.en:
$$オルソン$$
「You mean my little brother and sister...?」

758:t_1:69.en:
$$シャイア$$
「That's right. $$桂$$'s children are $$アテナ$$'s younger siblings.」

758:t_1:70.en:
$$ジャビー$$
「And since you married $$アテナ$$, $$オルソン$$, they're your younger siblings too.」

758:t_1:71.en:
$$桂$$
「That's how it is, partner. Let's savor this happiness together.」

758:t_1:72.en:
$$オルソン$$
「You're right. Then I think I will.」

758:t_1:73.en:
$$桂$$
(This is the hyperdimensional world born through the multiverse... This is where I and the ones I love will live.)

758:t_1:74.en:
$$桂$$
(Someday, I want to show everyone the happiness I've found.)

758:t_1:79.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Today's finally the tournament semifinals, $$キリコ$$. Even in $$バトリング$$, winning against that many tough opponents is impressive, plain and simple.」

758:t_1:80.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Win this and you're in the final...! If you're champion, the prize money's a fortune!」

758:t_1:81.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Still, it's a regular game. The prize is nothing compared to a real battle.」

758:t_1:82.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I won't fire a gun again until I have to.」

758:t_1:85.en:
$$ココナ$$
「That's right. It's better for $$フィアナ$$ too.」

758:t_1:88.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「The first semifinal is over. As expected, $$テイタニア$$ won.」

758:t_1:89.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Then $$キリコ$$ will face $$テイタニア$$ in the final!」

758:t_1:90.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「You're getting ahead of yourself. $$キリコ$$ still has his semifinal.」

758:t_1:91.en:
$$ココナ$$
「What are you talking about, old man!? There's no way $$キリコ$$ will lose!」

758:t_1:93.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Win, $$キリコ$$. You beat me, after all.」

758:t_1:95.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I want to use the prize money to buy $$バニラ$$ and $$ココナ$$ a wedding present too.」

758:t_1:97.en:
$$バニラ$$
「I'd appreciate that! We could open the $$ファンタムクラブ$$ in $$クメン$$ with that!」

758:t_1:98.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Things have settled down there too, thanks to $$ポタリア$$ and the others.」

758:t_1:99.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$キデーラ$$ has been urging us to visit too.」

758:t_1:100.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Then how about a trip to $$クメン$$, bringing little $$キリコ$$'s victory as a gift!」

758:t_1:103.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Make some coffee and wait for me.」

758:t_1:104.en:
$$キリコ$$
(I won't take up a gun again, unless someone tries to drag $$フィアナ$$ and me into battle...)

758:t_1:105.en:
$$キリコ$$
(These peaceful days we gained alongside our comrades in $c may be brief... But that's all right...)

758:t_1:106.en:
$$キリコ$$
(I'll live with $$フィアナ$$... today... and tomorrow too...)

758:t_1:110.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I've found you, $$宇宙クジラ$$!」

758:t_1:112.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Wait, $$バサラ$$! Did you forget that doing that got you caught up in a $$時空震動$$!?」

758:t_1:113.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「It's no use telling him, $$ミレーヌ$$. He doesn't mind being thrown into another world in the slightest.」

758:t_1:114.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バトル７$$, please respond! This is Captain $$ガムリン・木崎$$ of $$ダイヤモンドフォース$$! I've found $$熱気バサラ$$!」

758:t_1:115.en:
$$マックス$$
「This is $$バトル７$$. If possible, bring $$熱気バサラ$$ back to the fleet.」

758:t_1:117.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Even you can't stop my song, $$ガムリン$$!」

758:t_1:118.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Sorry, $$バサラ$$! I'm going to catch you today, no matter what!」

758:t_1:119.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「When you wander around, I get fewer chances to make a move on $$ミレーヌ$$!」

758:t_1:121.en:
$$ビヒーダ$$
「Stop being so pleased and settle this already.」

758:t_1:122.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Shut up, $$ガムリン$$! Nobody can stop me!」

758:t_1:123.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I'll sing when I want, as much as I want!」

758:t_1:125.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「But you always want to sing!」

758:t_1:127.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Honestly! If you keep wandering around like that, we won't even be able to go see everyone!」

758:t_1:128.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't worry. I'll get my sound to them too.」

758:t_1:130.en:
$$バサラ$$
「So today, I'll fire up my heart and sing again!」

758:t_1:131.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$宇宙クジラ$$! Galaxy! Dimensions! Listen to my song!!」

758:t_1:136.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Is he flying around in his $$ＥＸ－ギア$$ again?」

758:t_1:137.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Yes... He said he really loves this new planet's sky.」
